tensor_digest_definition: Sorted state keys; each UTF-8 JSON [name,str(dtype),shape] header is prefixed by its uint64 little-endian byte length; each CPU contiguous NumPy C-order tensor byte string is prefixed by its uint64 little-endian byte length. SHA-256 over the concatenation. Export host is little-endian.
export_note: Tensor-only export. All 476 tensors equal the original checkpoint exactly. Optimizer, scaler, random state and private configuration metadata omitted. Different container SHA-256 does not indicate different model weights.
